verdict.rationale: Thoropass has built-in recurring automation: access reviews remind users to start reviews on their policy's timelines, consecutive reviews build on prior ones, and monitors continuously check connected systems. However, none of the evidence shows users defining their own schedules for arbitrary jobs or workflows, whether in the UI, through an API, or via the MCP server. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling of custom recurring jobs/workflows, schedule management (cron/frequency settings), agent- or API-driven scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
